title: abutilon fraseri
intro: Abutilon fraseri, commonly known as the Fraser's abutilon or Fraser's bushmallow, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malvaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Abutilon fraseri include sedative and anxiolytic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. These bioactive compounds have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties, contributing to the plant's medicinal uses.
